{
  "title": "Reykjavik on a shoestring",
  "summary": "A gentler Sunday in Reykjavik that keeps the whales, swaps the pricey dome for free local colour, and eats well without emptying the nest.",
  "stops": [
    {
      "poi_id": "p11",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": "m2",
      "note": "The whales stay, as they should. We start here before the crowds and before the wallet gets a fright.",
      "start": "10:00",
      "end": "11:15"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p12",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "A free wander through the flea market gives us local life without the Perlan price tag.",
      "start": "11:30",
      "end": "12:30"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p17",
      "kind": "meal",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "Lunch at Kaffi Loki keeps us fed for a fair price, with a proper taste of Icelandic home cooking.",
      "start": "13:00",
      "end": "14:00"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p13",
      "kind": "activity",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "A short ride out to Grótta gives us sea air and a free photo stop, far cheaper than another museum.",
      "start": "14:45",
      "end": "15:45"
    },
    {
      "poi_id": "p20",
      "kind": "meal",
      "must_do_id": null,
      "note": "Dinner at Hlemmur Mathöll lets everyone pick their own plate without a four-dollar-sign fuss.",
      "start": "17:30",
      "end": "18:30"
    }
  ]
}
